race.comment: CAPTAIN MAVERICK (3) has his doubters but is as consistent as they come. Was collared on the line by ARTFUL GIRL over 2400m at Eagle Farm on soft ground after punching out three previous minor placings. Back to 2200m and meets the winner with a decent pull at the weights. This time.  As mentioned, ARTFUL GIRL (7) took the prize last time but now rises 2kgs. Is mixing her form but her peaks are good enough. SOCIAL OUTCAST (2) comes off an Eagle Farm win at generous odds, allowed to dictate a moderate tempo and keep them all at bay. Doubt he gets the same picnic this time but he deserves plenty of respect. TAPILDOODLEDO (1) is going better than his form reads and gets in well with another 3kg claimer aboard. Represents plenty of value. BARCELO (6) disappointed last time behind SOCIAL OUTCAST in an effort that was almost too bad to be true. Prior efforts line up well and he's worth forgiving.
